name: PassengerSpecialAssistanceDesk
tagline: Airport PRM desk: the right agent, the right equipment, every wait inside the service level.
description: A complete special-assistance (PRM) app for airports, ground handlers and airline desks: SSR-based skills and equipment for WCHR, WCHS, WCHC, BLND, DEAF, DPNA and MAAS, ambulift rules for remote stands, pre-notified vs walk-up service levels with live waits, agent shifts and overlaps, equipment demand against the fleet, best-match auto-assign and a full request workflow – in one PCF control for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Service levels: pre-notified vs late requests, live wait, on-time %
Agent roster with shifts (incl. night), overlap, skill-gap and off-shift checks
Equipment demand per hour vs fleet
Workflow with blocking rules, reasons and undo
Agent job sheet CSV and export
react: 16.14.0 (bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI)
